class UnequalIterablesError(ValueError):
    """Raised when iterables of different lengths are passed to zip_equal."""
    pass

def zip_equal(*iterables):
    """Yield tuples of elements from each of the iterables, only if they are of equal length.
    
    If the iterables have different lengths, raises UnequalIterablesError.
    
    >>> list(zip_equal([1,2,3], [4,5,6]))
    [(1, 4), (2, 5), (3, 6)]
    >>> list(zip_equal([1,2], [3,4,5]))
    Traceback (most recent call last):
        ...
    UnequalIterablesError: Iterables have different lengths
    """
    sentinel = object()
    iters = [iter(it) for it in iterables]
    for vals in zip_longest(*iters, fillvalue=sentinel):
        if sentinel in vals:
            raise UnequalIterablesError("Iterables have different lengths")
        yield vals
```
